title.value: Exploring validation metrics for offline model-based optimisation with diffusion models
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the content of the paper discussed, focusing on validation metrics and diffusion models in the context of offline model-based optimization.
title.quote: Exploring validation metrics for offline model-based optimisation with diffusion models

extractions.description: The paper investigates various validation metrics used in offline model-based optimization (MBO) where the goal is to use machine learning to generate candidates that maximize reward. The authors focus on identifying which validation metrics correlate best with ground truth for models trained without direct oracle access, specifically evaluating denoising diffusion models. The paper discusses validation metric proposals, their correlation with ground truth over simulated datasets, and how these insights can be transferred to real-world applications. It highlights important hyperparameters and provides a framework to guide the selection of models that can extrapolate. Additionally, it explores classifier-based and classifier-free guidance in diffusion models, with experiments conducted over several datasets.
